column1: # written verbatim from the inline reply (runner 10, H256, one Opus vision call, 29 Sept 2026, 101,286 subagent tokens, 25 s)
# GROUP A: A cursive minuscule "a": a closed, rounded bowl with a short upright stroke on its right and a small exit tail at the foot.
# GROUP B: A two-part cipher sign "43": a "4" shape (a diagonal and a crossbar on a long descending upright) joined to a small "3"-like hook on its right.
# GROUP C: A looped cipher sign, like a phi or an "8" on a stem: two or three stacked closed loops sitting on a long straight descender that slants left.
# GROUP D: A small round closed "o"-type bowl with no upright stroke on its right.
